program: Critical home repairs, accessibility and emergency housing safety
priceScope: Conditional annual full-recipient cost against limited repair health/resource benefits; not a whole-portfolio or marginal-gift expected value.

what: Rebuilding Together Colorado provides free critical repairs and modifications for vulnerable low-income homeowners.
The current recipient is the former Metro Denver affiliate, not the national organization.
A conditional health-plus-net-resource reference is about $5.86M per better life.
strengths: The original FY2024 filing identifies 72 homeowners and actual repair types.
Current eligibility, regional footprint and alternative repair providers are explicit.
The model keeps full time costs, possible harms and volunteer-resource sensitivities.
reservations: Homeowners, repair types and demographic categories overlap; they are not additional independent outcomes.
Local causal health and actual household savings remain unmeasured judgments.
The footprint includes El Paso County outside Denver's ten-county CBSA; donor-funded additional capacity is unknown.

sections.what: This legal recipient, EIN84-1514642, is Rebuilding Together Metro Denver Inc DBA Rebuilding Together Colorado. Services include larger Rebuilding Days projects, smaller Safe@Home repairs and urgent furnaces/water heaters. Some emergency work uses paid licensed trades, not only volunteers. Own donation page contains a FundraiseUp intake trigger; no transaction was made.
sections.monitoring: The original FY2024 filing reports72 low-income homeowners. The10 veterans,67 seniors,60 disabled and5 households with children overlap; repair categories can occur in the same home. Request distinct homes, residents, completed repairs, local county, sustained hazards resolved, falls/function and actual avoided household spending. Earlier2016 emergency-family figures are not substituted as current output.
sections.qualitative: Heating, water, plumbing and accessibility repairs can improve safety/function and prevent displacement, but the recipient does not report a local causal utility coefficient. Half of households incremental to alternatives, .5 clinical response, .02 utility gain for3years and.85 local share are explicit judgments. County/municipal programs, Brothers Redevelopment and family or private repair are counterfactuals. Completed repairs are not automatically causal health gains.
sections.cost: FY2024 full expenses $492,736; netted event/gaming/COGS fields blank. The$14,458 special event line is already functional expense and not added twice. FY2023 $321,790; FY2022 $483,389. The matched72 homeowners constrain the annual scope, not a next-gift price. Recognized program-cost sensitivity $370,902 omits allocated overhead; 2050 reported volunteer hours × judged$25/h adds$51,250 as a social-resource sensitivity, not measured payroll.
sections.funding: Free repairs do not mean zero household time/access cost. Full judged$50 costs and possible stress apply to every exposed household even if benefits fail. Judged$500 resources are actual avoided otherwise-paid energy/access/repair spending net of offsets, not retail repair value or appreciated property capital. Positive overlap with health/security is discounted; negative costs are not. Public/utility and volunteer resource losses are distinct sensitivities, without counting grants as new household income. Current owner-occupied eligibility excludes mortgage/tax delinquency and some renters, limiting reach.

sources.title: Current eligibility, repair programs and alternatives

model.costScope: Whole FY2024 recipient annual functional cost with netted-expense audit, not marginal donation; partial repair benefit model with program-cost and full-resource sensitivities.
model.geographicAttribution: Adams, Arapahoe, Denver, Douglas and Jefferson plus El Paso service counties; g.85 judged share within fixed ten-county CBSA19740, not measured headquarters share.
model.formula: Health = N × unique × b × eligible × completion × response × q × discounted finite T × g minus full exposed harm. Signed net household resources are joint logged once using 0.5 log(after/before); price =10C/(health + income equivalents) when positive.
model.counterfactual: Municipal/county repair programs, Brothers Redevelopment, household funds and other providers may supply repairs without this recipient.
model.attribution: b.5 additionality separate from clinical response; unique homes and local share hypotheses explicit; full exposed harms/access costs retained at b0.
model.uncertainty: No local controlled utility, actual savings, repair persistence or marginal capacity measured. Numerical reference conditional, broader displacement/community effects unknown not zero.
model.nativeOutcomes: FY2024 72 homeowners and overlapping repair/demographic counts;2050 volunteer hours; not national nearly100,000 volunteers or cumulative thousands local beneficiaries.
